$ yg check --json --top
exit: 1
--- stdout
{
  "schema": "yg-error/1",
  "code": "usage",
  "what": "--top cannot be combined with --json.",
  "why": "--top narrows the TEXT report — fewer blocks, same counts. --json emits one machine document that always carries the whole run, so there is nothing for a narrowing flag to narrow, and a document trimmed to a few findings would read as a smaller problem instead of a smaller rendering.",
  "next": {
    "command": null,
    "text": "Run: yg check --json (the whole run as a document), or yg check --top <n> (the narrowed text view)."
  }
}
--- stderr
error[usage]: --top cannot be combined with --json.
  why:  --top narrows the TEXT report — fewer blocks, same counts. --json emits one machine document that always carries the whole run, so there is nothing for a narrowing flag to narrow, and a document trimmed to a few findings would read as a smaller problem instead of a smaller rendering.
next: yg check --json (the whole run as a document), or yg check --top <n> (the narrowed text view).
